description:
Meet the Pocket Rocket Further: a new variant of the Pocket Rocket — Bicycling.com’s Folding Road Bike of the Year 2026 — transformed from tarmac specialist into a lightweight gravel machine. Hand-built, custom-fit, packs into a suitcase, and ready to tear up the crunchy stuff anywhere in the world.

First bikes deliver this December.
Order before September 30 with code 2822 and get $250 off shipping or accessories.*

The Pocket Rocket Further takes Bike Friday’s award-winning Pocket Rocket and turns it from the ultimate traveling road bike into a gravel machine — ready to eat up the rough stuff wherever you are in the world.

Gravel riding grew from a natural desire to stray from the beaten path, escape the traffic, and explore what’s out there. The Further is the first Bike Friday designed for gravel from the start, with every modification made specifically for the job.

A widened fork clears tires up to 1.6″, opening the door to gravel roads and backcountry routes while maintaining the benafits of a road bike feel. We took what we learned from over 30 years and thousands of Pocket Rocket customers trips and added six new features to design this new bike— hydraulic disc brakes, flat mount calipers, thru-axles, replaceable dropouts, clearance for tires up to 1.6 in and a UDH hanger. We also kept focused on including universal standards, the ability to be serviceable anywhere in the world for decades to come.

And because it’s a Bike Friday, the Further does something no other gravel bike can: it folds for travel. Which matters, because gravel isn’t just one thing — there’s Kansas flint, Tuscan white road, Icelandic lava, Oregon forest-service chunk — and most of it is nowhere near your house. The Further helps you go collect them all!

Hand-built in Eugene and custom-fit to your measurements, the Further packs into an airline-checkable suitcase. No oversize fees, no rental-bike compromise, no leaving your custom fit at home.

High performance, nimble ride, built for long miles, great on hills with 20 inches (451mm) wheels.

When folded it fits into a space 34x33x12” (varies by frame size) (86x83x31 cm) easily fits in a car trunk in minutes

Built to fit you from effective top tube lengths ranging 48cm to 62cm

Pocket Rocket Further frame built for riders up to 220 lbs (100 kg)

Packs into a standard airline check-able suitcase

Compatible with Front and Rear Racks

New for 2026: Hydraulic disc brake compatible frame for stronger, more consistent stopping power in all conditions

New for 2026: Flat mount brake caliper frame mounts, the modern universal mounting standard for drop-bar bikes

New for 2026: UDH-ready (Universal Derailleur Hanger), replaceable at any bike shop worldwide and ready for SRAM Full Mount drive-trains

components.description: Flat Mount Disc brake with choice of Hydraulic or Mechanical depending on your component group choice.

We offer drop bars with several widths available. A split handlebar is available and recommended for packing in a suitcase. If you have a specific drop-bar style or width you want please write a note in your order or contact our bike experts and they will insure your specific choice is added to your order.

Will disassemble to fit into a standard airline check-able Samsonite suitcase. 31 x 21 x 12” (varies slightly with frame size and component selections) Upgrading to split handlebars makes packing easier.
451mm double wall rims, Thru Axle Hubs ( Front 12×100, Rear 12×142), Tires are 1-1/8" with presta valve tubes, and clearance for up to 1.6".
